name: MuscleTech 100% Whey Isolate
ingredients_raw: Whey Protein Isolate (91%), Natural and Artificial Flavours (Chocolate, Vanilla), Cocoa (Processed with Alkali), Gum Blend (Cellulose Gum [Stabilizer], Xanthan Gum (Emulsifier), (0.6%) (Saccharomyces boulardii, Amylase [from Aspergillus flavus var. oryzae, Whole], Papain Carrageenan [Emulsifier]), Soy or Sunflower Lecithin (Emulsifier), Probiotic and Enzyme Blend [from Carica papaya, Fruit]), Salt (Flavour Enhancer), Sucralose (Sweetener), Vitamin and Mineral Blend (0.2%) (L-Ascorbic Acid, Zinc Oxide, Nicotinamide, Ergocalciferol, Calcium D-Pantothenate, D-Biotin, Pyridoxine Hydrochloride, Cyanocobalamin, Riboflavin, Thiamine Hydrochloride, Folic Acid), Silicon Dioxide (Anti-Caking Agent). Allergen Warning: Contains milk and soy ingredients. Processed in a facility that also processes tree nuts and fish ingredients. This product contains sucralose (INS 955). CONTAINS NON-CALORIC SWEETENER. DIRECTIONS: Mix 1 serving (1 scoop) in 200 mL of cold water or skim milk in a shaker cup. Use between major meals or before and after exercise. Take up to 2 servings per day. Read the entire label before use and follow directions provided. Recommended Dose: 2 servings per day. Whey Protein Isolate with Probiotic Powder WARNING: NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE. For adult use only, not recommended for children. Product is not to be used as a substitute for a varied diet. Do not use if you are pregnant or nursing. Consult a medical doctor before use if you have a medical condition or before starting a diet or exercise program. Do not exceed the recommended daily usage.
